content:
The task was successfully completed by implementing a multi-sheet Excel report and a Word executive summary with robust data normalization.
The solution utilized openpyxl to manage specific sheet names and used .strip().upper() to handle case-sensitive validation for 'Storage Class' and 'Temp Status'. Data was aggregated by 'Item Code' and 'Supplier' using a dictionary before being written to the 'Summary' sheet with a 'Grand Total' row. The final Word document correctly integrated these aggregated totals to identify high-priority items as required.
